selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific classification of the instrument and distinguish it from other architectural structures or similar objects.
To verify the physical separation between the metallic pipes and the wooden background, ensuring no 'melting' or boundary bleeding artifacts common in AI generation.
To audit the individual integrity of the thin vertical pipes, checking for fusion or irregular spacing anomalies.

focus_areas: Boundary sharpness between metallic pipes and wooden casing
Regularity and parallelism of vertical pipes
Texture consistency of wood grain and metal reflections
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the regularity of the pipe spacing. AI generators often struggle with repeating thin vertical lines, causing them to wobble, merge, or vary in thickness inconsistently. Verify if the decorative grille patterns above the pipes are structurally logical or if they exhibit gibberish/melting artifacts.
